title: Smaller and Smaller
subtitle: Infinity toward a point: a self-similar tiling
technique: Square rings that halve toward the centre, each a pinwheel of four 3 × 1 rectangles bent into interlocking dolphins whose edges match exactly across scales; the tiling repeats under a ×2 scaling with a quarter turn, so the zoom loops
refs: M. C. Escher, Smaller and Smaller, 1956
blurb: Interlocking dolphins halve in size ring by ring toward a vanishing point, in an endless spiral zoom that loops because the tiling is the same at every scale.
